caption:
Eight weeks left of the year. No pressure, just a plan.

I don't want a frantic December. I want a soft landing. So this week I'm choosing what to finish, what to let go and when to rest.

What's the one thing you want to finish before the year ends?

slides.title: 8 weeks left. Here's how I finish softly.

slides.heading: Pick three finish lines
slides.body: Not ten goals. Three things that would make this year feel complete. Write them where you'll see them.

slides.heading: Let one thing go
slides.body: Every year has a goal that no longer fits. Cross it out on purpose. That's not failing, that's editing.

slides.heading: Book your rest first
slides.body: Put your days off in the calendar now, before December fills itself.

slides.heading: One small step a week
slides.body: Eight weeks, eight steps. Small and steady beats a last-minute sprint.

slides.title: Save this for your Sunday plan
slides.body: A calm finish starts this week.
